races._comment: Races organized by realm. starting_skills is a dict {skill_id: level}. starting_spells is an array of {school or schools, level, count}. elemental_affinity_bonuses is innate racial affinity independent of skills. reincarnation_weight is relative probability of being reborn as this race (higher = more common).

red_devil.name: Red Devil
red_devil.description: Hot-headed and driven by anger and lust, red devils are the finest warriors in the Hells. They hold the armouries, the drill grounds and most of the ranks worth holding, and the arrangement suits everyone: a red devil given something to hit is a red devil not presently thinking about the other thing. The good ones are genuinely magnificent. The rest are the reason the fire hells burn.

blue_devil.name: Blue Devil
blue_devil.description: Cold and calculating, blue devils keep grudges long after they were forgotten in the realms above. The ice hells reward patience and blue devils have nothing but, so they hold the jails, the ledgers of the condemned and the long quiet posts nobody else will take. They do not raise their voices. They write it down, and they are still holding the page an age later when it finally becomes useful.

yellow_devil.name: Yellow Devil
yellow_devil.description: Greedy and proud, yellow devils tend to cluster wherever wealth changes hands. Every road toll, caravan escort and moneylender's back room in the Hells has one in it, and the courts run on the credit they extend. A yellow devil will not fight you if there is any other option, because fighting is expensive and there is almost always another option.

green_devil.name: Green Devil
green_devil.description: Quick-witted and paranoid, green devils make for excellent operatives and terrible friends. They do the work the other castes prefer not to have witnessed — the scouting, the quiet removals, the contents of a rival's correspondence. A green devil assumes it is being watched at all times, which is exhausting to be near and, given what green devils do for a living, entirely correct.

black_devil.name: Black Devil
black_devil.description: Spawned from the Outer Dark, black devils live off confusion and fear. They are not native to the Hells so much as admitted to them, and the other castes keep a careful distance without ever quite saying why. Black devils take the sorcerous work, the interrogations that are really experiments, and the offices at the ends of corridors. They are the best-educated things in the realm and the worst company in it.

white_devil.name: White Devil
white_devil.description: Lazy and a bit ditzy, white devils make pleasant company as far as hell's denizens go. This is not innocence — a white devil will hand you to the courts as readily as any of them — it is simply that being agreeable takes less effort than the alternative, and effort is the one thing they genuinely object to. They negotiate, they host, they smooth things over, and they are the only caste anybody is ever pleased to see.

rolang.name: Rolang
rolang.description: The newly dead of the hungry ghost realm. Rolangs have been in the world of the dead for a relatively short time and are the least conscious of its inhabitants. Young walking dead are dim and animalistic — rigid, slow, moving in a jerky jiangshi-like manner — and only over long ages do some begin to develop awareness of their condition. Most rot away into skeletons. A rare few are preserved by alchemical and yogic arts and become the lords of their kind.

preserved.name: Preserved
preserved.description: Alchemical oils, mantras, and mineral compounds have halted your decay while others rotted to bone. The lords of their kind among the Rolang — rare, aware, and dangerous. You remember considerably more than most of your kind, and have had long years of stillness to put that memory to use.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Freed from the needs of the flesh by unstoppable decay, skeletons have had time to think. Most maintain the dryness of their sprawling catacombs and praise the blessings of abundant calcium with cheerful enthusiasm. Conscious skeletons are far more common than among the newly dead — the long wait in the grave strips away the animal confusion and leaves something clear-eyed and surprisingly sociable behind.

dralha.name: Dralha
dralha.description: Warrior-kings who refused to relinquish their power at death and rebuilt their dominion from beyond the grave. Dralha are former chieftains, generals, and conquerors who linger in the charnel grounds surrounded by the spirits of those who served them in life. They lead through force and presence, wielding weapons with the same authority they carried in the living world.

gyelpo.name: Gyelpo
gyelpo.description: Powerful tantric practitioners and sorcerers who accumulated enough spiritual force in life to persist after death as kings of the spirit world. Where dralha rule through arms and loyalty, gyelpos rule through binding oaths, ritual contracts, and the weight of accumulated power. Shugden is the archetype: a sorcerer who refused to dissolve, who built a new throne from obligation and fear.

dre.name: Dré
dre.description: Ghosts in the oldest and most literal sense: consciousness that has shed its body but not its attachments, drifting through the charnel grounds like smoke through bone. Dré are the most dissolved of the preta, barely present in the physical world. They feel little of its violence but remain bound to it by the thread of whatever they could not let go.

vetala.name: Vetala
vetala.description: Highly intelligent and curious tricksters who inhabit the charnel grounds. Vetalas are ambivalent towards the living and arbitrary in their dealings — sometimes helpful, sometimes dangerous, always keeping their own counsel. They drain life force through magic rather than physical violence, produce vivid illusions, and have a natural propensity for the arcane arts. Their propensity for rhetoric, humor, and meditation means they can usually talk their way out of a fight, though they rarely feel obliged to.

naga.name: Naga
naga.description: Before the first apes descended from the trees, these serpentine beings raised their glimmering cities with ingenuity and wisdom.

yaksha.name: Yaksha
yaksha.description: Something is being guarded — a spring, a hoard, a promise older than the hill it was sworn on. Ask which, and the answer arrives with the weight of a matter settled long before you were born.

human.name: Human
human.description: Beings of potential and choice, balanced in all aspects

shaza.name: Shaza
shaza.description: The predators of the underworld, the shaza aggressively seek out bodies to devour. Where the rest of the preta starve on principle, the shaza found the loophole: it is not hunger that is cursed, only the eating of ordinary food. So they eat the dead, and lately the not-quite-dead, and they have got very fast and very quiet in the process. A shaza in a charnel ground is competition. A shaza on a road has already decided.

yidag.name: Yidag
yidag.description: Bellies distended with insatiable hunger, throats constricted to a hair's width — these beings are the most unfortunate embodiment of the karma that created their world. This is the inner obscuration, and the kind everyone means when they say hungry ghost: the food is found, the food is reached, and the food will not go down. A yidag has spent its entire existence within arm's length of the one thing it needs.

skeleton_silver.name: Silver Skeleton
skeleton_silver.description: Not many withstand the trials of the underworld without losing their compassion. Those who have managed that feat remain as healers and helpers, looking with hope for the future to the worlds far above. They keep the sick-houses of the bone cities and go out to the roads where nobody else will, and they are the reason a preta with a wound sometimes lives to regret it. The other skeletons regard them with something between reverence and mild embarrassment.

skeleton_copper.name: Copper Skeleton
skeleton_copper.description: Skeletons born of molten copper mirrors in the court of the Skeleton King of the Setting Sun find themselves especially attuned to the arts of power and magnetism. A copper skeleton walks into a room and the room reorganises itself slightly, and nobody present can say afterwards quite when they agreed to anything. They rarely hold office. They are usually standing just behind whoever does.

skeleton_golden.name: Golden Skeleton
skeleton_golden.description: Gleaming in the flickering light of the crypt cities, golden skeletons are respected nobles among their people. The gold is not paint and not plating; it went in at the making, and it cannot be lost, sold or acquired by anyone born without it. So the aristocracy of the bone cities is visible at a hundred paces and entirely closed, and a golden skeleton who wants out of the arrangement has nowhere in the realm to go where it is not obvious.

skeleton_iron.name: Iron Skeleton
skeleton_iron.description: Born of broken weapons on endless battlefields of the multiverse, iron skeletons are hard and unyielding, the most serious and driven of their kin. They came out of the ground already knowing what they were for, which the others find enviable and iron skeletons find no comfort at all. They rust, alone among their kind, and they keep working through it without mentioning it to anybody.

skeleton_turquoise.name: Turquoise Skeleton
skeleton_turquoise.description: Prancing cheerfully in their rainbow skirts and flowery headdresses, turquoise skeletons serve as jesters, dancers and, often enough, grand viziers to the Great Bone Kings. The three roles are less distinct than they sound. A turquoise skeleton is permitted to say the thing nobody else in the court may say, provided it is said while dancing, and a great many succession crises in the crypt cities have been settled by somebody in a flowered hat making a joke at exactly the right moment.

bhramara.name: Bhramara
bhramara.description: The nature of the relationship between a bhramara and their hive eludes the grasp of even the most empathetic of other beings. What is obvious is their coordination and refinement.

karka.name: Karka
karka.description: Armoured, unhurried, and entirely uninterested in your schedule. The karka hold the reef passes the way a door holds a frame, and no one has yet argued one out of the way.

matsya.name: Matsya
matsya.description: In the ocean, the slow and unwary quickly become a meal. The matsya are the children of those who lived, and they will do their best to make their ancestors proud.

makara.name: Makara
makara.description: Deep beneath the waves dwell creatures strange and old, wielding weird magic and practicing yogas that only make sense for the cephalopod body.

dura.name: Dura
dura.description: Patient and persistent, the Dura have been here longer than most things that walk. They have long mastered the secrets of the earth and became famous as farmers, traders and sturdy warriors.

khadga.name: Khadga
khadga.description: The blade-limbed mantis, the dragonfly, the ambush grasshopper. They live by the first strike, unconquered in their weight class.

patanga.name: Patanga
patanga.description: Poison, silk, iridescence, and a tendency to appear where least expected, the Patanga know how to kindle fear and wonder alike.

rakshasa.name: Rakshasa
rakshasa.description: Shape-shifting lords of the jungle, presiding over the ancient cults of the hunt. What a tiger becomes, given lifetimes.

varaha.name: Varaha
varaha.description: A low decision made at speed. Varaha neither bluff nor can be bluffed, and the forest has long since learned to concede the trail.

marjara.name: Marjara
marjara.description: Dappled light is their native country — the flicker where a shape might be, and then is not. Whatever they wanted from you, they have usually already taken it.

gana.name: Gana
gana.description: Alone, a middling thing with good teeth. Together, nothing in the forest outruns us.

mriga.name: Mriga
mriga.description: The feeling of dew on your antlers, the juicy new leaves of spring, the kinship of the herd! It is a good life.

vanara.name: Vanara
vanara.description: Nothing in the canopy is fastened down, and anything that is merely constitutes the opening of a project. They are funny deliberately, which is the part people underestimate.

shyena.name: Shyena
shyena.description: The stoop is one decision, made at height and never revised. From up there the world sorts cleanly into things worth the dive and things that are not.

kapota.name: Kapota
kapota.description: Every message that mattered was carried by something small and grey that nobody thought to stop. The kapota remember all of them, and they remember who was lying.

uluka.name: Uluka
uluka.description: They ask questions in the tone of someone who already has the answer and is deciding whether you deserve it. Nothing that hunts in silence is ever entirely trusted.

flame_imp.name: Flame Imp
flame_imp.description: Hell's smallest arsonists, hatched in the flue of something larger and never entirely put out since. A flame imp is the reason a fire that was under control stops being under control, and it will tell you so at length, from a safe distance, at speed. Not brave. Very difficult to extinguish.

frost_imp.name: Frost Imp
frost_imp.description: Cold, small and patient in a way nothing else in the Hells manages. Frost imps hang in the roofs of the ice caverns waiting for something underneath them to stop moving, and they are prepared to wait a very long time for it. They rarely start anything. They are usually there at the end of it.

gravel_imp.name: Gravel Imp
gravel_imp.description: Squat, grey and far heavier than their size accounts for, gravel imps live in the spoil heaps and tunnel walls wherever the digging is. They collect: bolts, teeth, coins, buttons, hinges, anything with an edge or a number on it. A gravel imp's nest is the nearest thing the Hells have to a museum, and it is not for sale.

static_imp.name: Static Imp
static_imp.description: A shriek with wings on it. Static imps travel the ridge lines in loose crackling clouds, and the hair standing up on your arms is the whole of the warning you get. Nothing that happens anywhere near them stays quiet, which makes them useless as thieves and unbeatable as an alarm.

tinnitus_imp.name: Tinnitus Imp
tinnitus_imp.description: The ringing that starts when the screaming stops. Tinnitus imps are barely visible and never quite absent, roosting in the dark over the courts and taking in everything said beneath them. They know a great deal. Getting any of it back out in an order that makes sense is the difficulty.

sloth_imp.name: Sloth Imp
sloth_imp.description: Soft, slow and entirely unbothered, sloth imps hang from the warm vents and decline to be anywhere else. Every other thing in the Hells is going somewhere in a hurry, and the sloth imp has watched the whole of it go past twice. They are unexpectedly good company. They are very hard to move.

wretch.name: Wretch
wretch.description: The Hells have two populations. One of them works here. The wretches are the other — reborn as the reason the place exists rather than as its staff, and owed nothing by anyone in it. No caste, no colour, no element, no rights, and no share of the infernal fire that lets a devil find the heat comfortable. What a wretch has is that it is still walking, which is more than most of its cohort managed.

chidrib.name: Chidrib
chidrib.description: The outer obscuration, and the walkers of the preta realm. A chidrib can hear of a river a month away and set out for it, and find guards on the bank, or a dry bed, or water that turns as they kneel to it. Nothing is withheld from them exactly. It is simply never there by the time they arrive. No one in the realm has covered more ground, and none of it has come to anything.

zadrib.name: Zadrib
zadrib.description: The obscuration of food and drink: they can swallow, and they should not. Whatever a zadrib takes in catches on the way down, so they burn from the inside outward and go back to eating regardless. The flames standing off their mouths are how you see them coming in the dark, and how they find each other. Of all the preta they are the least pitiable and the most dangerous, because the fire that is killing them will answer to them first.

backgrounds._comment: Background definitions with starting skills and small attribute tweaks. starting_skills is a dict {skill_id: level}. attribute_modifiers are small flavour adjustments on top of race modifiers. available_races is a whitelist of race IDs (omit or empty = universal). weight is relative reincarnation probability.

wanderer.name: Quickwit
wanderer.description: A traveler who has seen many places and learned to read people and terrain alike.

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.description: A student of ancient texts and wisdom, more at home with scrolls than swords.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: A trader of goods and services, sharp-tongued and sharper-eyed for opportunity.

monk.name: Monk
monk.description: A practitioner of spiritual disciplines, attuned to inner forces most ignore.

noble.name: Noble
noble.description: Born to privilege and power, accustomed to commanding others.

reveler.name: Reveler
reveler.description: A social creature of feasts, festivals, and flattery. Charm opens more doors than keys.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Trained in the arts of combat, body hardened by years of drill and battle.

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.description: A worker of the land, with tireless endurance and practical knowledge.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: A warrior who fights with uncontrolled fury, trading precision for annihilating force.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: A protector of places and people, trained to hold ground and outlast attackers.

raider.name: Raider
raider.description: One who takes what they want by force, quick to strike and quicker to vanish.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: A tracker and killer of prey, patient and precise at range.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: One who delivers final judgment. Efficient, dispassionate, feared.

torturer.name: Torturer
torturer.description: A professional in the application of suffering. Methodical, knowledgeable about bodies and their limits, and utterly without sentiment.

soul_jailer.name: Soul Jailer
soul_jailer.description: A warden of the condemned, guarding souls sentenced to suffer. Brutal and disciplined in equal measure.

infernal_scribe.name: Infernal Scribe
infernal_scribe.description: A keeper of sins and karmic ledgers. In hell, bureaucracy is its own form of torment — and these figures wield it like a weapon.

penitent.name: Penitent
penitent.description: A suffering soul who turned their torment inward and found something unexpected: clarity. Frail at first, but possessed of a spiritual awareness that others in hell have entirely forgotten.

spy.name: Spy
spy.description: An operative who trades in information, deception, and precisely timed violence. Trusted by no one, useful to everyone.

shambler.name: Shambler
shambler.description: Barely conscious, driven by hunger. What remains of a person after death strips everything else away.
todo: needs_upside: shambler is strictly penalizing (-7 net) — add a compensating passive ability eventually, e.g. immunity to fear/mind effects or reduced XP cost on unarmed/might

former_soldier.name: Former Soldier
former_soldier.description: Death did not end their service. Muscle memory survives the grave.

plague_victim.name: Plague Victim
plague_victim.description: Carries the sickness that killed them. Even in death, the rot spreads.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.description: A speaker between peoples, trained to find common ground in the most hostile of rooms.

temple_warden.name: Temple Warden
temple_warden.description: A protector of sacred places, combining martial readiness with spiritual discipline.

priest.name: Priest
priest.description: A servant of the divine, trained in ceremony and in the healing and harmful uses of sacred power.

preserved.name: Preserved
preserved.description: Alchemical arts halted your decay. Oils, mantras and mineral compounds have kept you intact while others rotted to bone. You remember considerably more than most of your kind.

bog_warden.name: Bog Warden
bog_warden.description: Long years of standing knee-deep in the same patch of swamp have made you territorial and surprisingly canny about it. You know every root and current. Others stumble; you do not.

catacomb_keeper.name: Catacomb Keeper
catacomb_keeper.description: You tend the dry places. You know where every bone is, who it belonged to, and how long they have been here. The catacombs are yours and you maintain them with cheer and precision.

bone_dancer.name: Bone Dancer
bone_dancer.description: You rattle with purpose where others grimace. A drum, a flourish, a joke at the right moment — you discovered that morale is its own kind of magic, and yours is inexhaustible.

charnel_yogi.name: Charnel Yogi
charnel_yogi.description: You meditate where death is most concentrated. The proximity to dissolution, to rot and impermanence, has sharpened your understanding of the mind and weakened your attachment to the body.

coral_guard.name: Coral Guard
coral_guard.description: You held a post at the outer walls of the palace. The tidal patterns of watch-change are in your bones.

palace_vizier.name: Vizier of the Deep Court
palace_vizier.description: You attended the Naga King, drafted proclamations in brine-script, and read the omens in current-patterns.

sea_dancer.name: Sea-Silk Dancer
sea_dancer.description: In the crystal hall you moved like a current through still water. The court watched. The King smiled.

deep_hunter.name: Hunter of the Open Current
deep_hunter.description: You roam the deep water alone. What others call the hunt is to you a long meditation in moving silence.

wreck_gleaner.name: Gleaner of Drowned Palaces
wreck_gleaner.description: The surface-folk build ships and lose them to the deep. You have walked through more of their halls than any of them ever did.

tide_seer.name: Seer of Currents
tide_seer.description: The naga lineages carry old knowledge. You read futures in the way water moves around stone.

current_herald.name: Herald of the Undersea Roads
current_herald.description: News travels fast in the deep. You are faster.

boundary_walker.name: Walker Between Worlds
boundary_walker.description: You have always lived at the edge where ocean meets sky, where river meets sea. The in-between is home.

hive_architect.name: Hive Architect
hive_architect.description: The comb is not built — it grows, cell by cell, through ten thousand coordinated decisions. You were one of them.

network_node.name: Node of the Queen's Web
network_node.description: You held a position in the real-time flow of the hive's collective mind. Not a soldier, not a builder — a relay, a processor, a voice in the continuous hum.

far_scout.name: Far Scout
far_scout.description: The hive's eyes go further than its walls. You mapped the meadow in pollen-language and brought it home in your body.

honey_alchemist.name: Honey-Keeper
honey_alchemist.description: The honey is not food. It is memory, medicine, and slow fire. You know the difference between a healing batch and a poisoned one.

caravan_guard.name: Caravan Guard
caravan_guard.description: The trade roads between hive-cities need walking. You walk them heavy and slow, and nothing touches the cargo.

tunneler.name: Tunneler
tunneler.description: You dig. What others call the underworld is simply where you work. The roots of the meadow are familiar as a face.

tunnel_merchant.name: Tunnel Merchant
tunnel_merchant.description: The surface roads belong to those who fear nothing. The tunnel roads belong to you. Your caravan of great beetles moves slow and sure through passages older than memory, and the surface predators never knew you passed.

still_hunter.name: Still Hunter
still_hunter.description: You do not chase. You find the right place, and you wait. The prey comes to you eventually. It always does.

blade_contemplative.name: Blade Contemplative
blade_contemplative.description: The mantis holds perfectly still before it moves. So do you. The strike is not an act of violence — it is the end of a very long thought.

jaina.name: Jaina
jaina.description: You looked at your blades and understood the problem. They were made for one thing only, and that thing leaves a mark on the soul. You chose the longer road: discipline, the practice of not-harming, and finally the great fast that others call death but you know as the last purification.
todo: karma_wiring: Jaina characters should accumulate animal-realm karma more slowly and drift toward human/god karma through non-violent play choices. Wire a background event_tag (jaina) into KarmaSystem so that karma-modifying event outcomes reduce animal karma at a discount and amplify human/god gains. The long fast (sallekhana) could eventually be a late-game event triggered by high yoga + jaina background tag.

flame_seeker.name: Flame-Seeker
flame_seeker.description: The flame is a teacher. You have studied it your whole life. It has not yet consumed you.

pollen_rishi.name: Pollen Rishi
pollen_rishi.description: You move between the flowering nodes of the meadow's invisible geography, accumulating knowledge the way a wing accumulates dust.

meadow_ward.name: Meadow Ward
meadow_ward.description: You are bound to a place. The meadow's health is your health. Strangers who wish safe passage learn to speak to you first.

trickster.name: Trickster
trickster.description: You live for the moment the illusion lands. Misdirection, impossible vanishings, arguments that fold in on themselves — you treat confusion as both art form and survival strategy.

lord_of_the_range.name: Lord of the Range
lord_of_the_range.description: Every tree in three valleys is marked. When lesser things feel watched, they are right.

the_hungry.name: The Hungry
the_hungry.description: The hunger is not a problem. It is the condition of becoming.

maneater.name: Maneater
maneater.description: They tell bedtime stories to their children about her, unable to see her dark silhouette lurking behind the window.

old_tusk.name: Old Tusk
old_tusk.description: Forty seasons in these hills. I know which hollows flood in the rains and which stay dry. Where the healing clay is for the wallow. The slope where truffle runs deepest. The young ones follow me because memory outlasts tusks.

sounder_guard.name: Sounder Guard
sounder_guard.description: When something comes for the piglets it meets me first. There are boar-marks on wolves, leopards, a bear that learned better. The front of my face is a record of everything that has tested what is mine.

mycelium_tender.name: Mycelium Tender
mycelium_tender.description: Most of the forest walks above the real richness — the fungal networks, the tuber gardens, the mycelium world that feeds everything else from below. I work underneath.

sounder_matron.name: Sounder Matron
sounder_matron.description: She doesn't lead by being the largest or the most aggressive. She leads because she remembers the year the eastern valley flooded, and the year the wolves came in winter, and what worked both times. The sounder follows her because the sounder has tested every alternative.

cache_master.name: Cache Master
cache_master.description: Three kills in the ironwood tree. Two more near the river crossing. Memory is the art — a leopard who forgets their caches starves in winter. I remember every one. I have never been hungry.

canopy_ambush.name: Canopy Ambush
canopy_ambush.description: They look for danger on the ground. They check behind rocks, test the wind for scent. They never look up. By the time they see me I am already resolved.

forest_drifter.name: Forest Drifter
forest_drifter.description: No particular territory. No particular schedule. The road between the settlements has interesting smells — traders with dried meat, merchants with shiny things, pilgrims with nothing worth stealing. A hunt when hungry, a trade when bored, a long sleep in a warm patch of sunlight when neither seems worth the effort.

hedonist.name: Hedonist
hedonist.description: …the feast after the hunt, the fear on a stranger's face, the music from the village fire that reaches the treeline — all this is the blood of experience, and I will have my fill!

realm_walker.name: Realm Walker
realm_walker.description: He has traveled far, in this world and beyond. He learned a lot, tricked many and ate quite a few, too.

blood_drinker.name: Blood Drinker
blood_drinker.description: This is not their first incarnation in this body, and probably not the last, looking on how they savour the hunt.

ancestor_priest.name: Ancestor Priest
ancestor_priest.description: The chiefs and heroes are laid to rest with the trophies of their most glorious hunts and offered blood mead when the moon is full.

the_sensate.name: The Sensate
the_sensate.description: They left the forests a lifetime ago, for the delights only civilized life can offer. Now they hunt by seduction, by art, by magic — and their prey hides in silks and perfume, and seems rather excited to be hunted.

range_reader.name: Range Reader
range_reader.description: When I run, I am eyes, I am ears, I am heart. I notice the colour that does not belong, the shadow that holds still while the leaves move.

bonfire_dancer.name: Bonfire Dancer
bonfire_dancer.description: These? They make a clinking sound when I move, and these here are to reflect lights and sparkle, and this one is —

herbalist.name: Herbalist
herbalist.description: The forest speaks of cures and poisons, if you know how to listen. When you break a branch, you see little. They see the weather, time, soil, animals and fungi, spirits and the dead.

elder_voice.name: Elder Voice
elder_voice.description: Not the fastest, not the strongest, but the one who can keep the pack alive the longest.

troop_elder.name: Troop Elder
troop_elder.description: I know which fig ripens first and which mango is always bitter. I know who should not sit next to whom at the sleeping tree, which young males are building coalitions, which females are calculating. The troop is a city in the canopy.

shrine_keeper.name: Shrine Keeper
shrine_keeper.description: The great fig tree has been sacred since before memory. I leave offerings at the roots — a smooth stone, a bright beetle, a length of vine arranged just so. I do not know why. My mother did it. And hers.

jugaad.name: Jugaad
jugaad.description: The camp near the river has a forge. I watched them for a season before I went in. They thought I wanted food. I wanted to understand what they were doing with fire and metal. The first tool I made was better than theirs. The seventh one they couldn't explain. I take requests now, in exchange for food and a formal agreement with their dogs.

forest_thief.name: Forest Thief
forest_thief.description: The settlements at the forest edge have interesting things — bright cloth, sweet foods, objects whose purpose I don't understand but which catch the light magnificently. I know which dogs bark and which don't. I know when the guards sleep.

sky_lord.name: Sky Lord
sky_lord.description: Three valleys. Every road, field, and creature visible at once from the high thermal. Others look at their feet and call that seeing. You look at everything from above and call it home. The ground is not the world. The ground is what you look at when you want to know where you are.

stooper.name: Stooper
stooper.description: Two hundred wing-lengths of silent fall. The wind becomes a pressure, then a scream, then nothing — because at the end of the stoop there is no more thinking, only the moment of contact. Everything else you do in your life is preparation for this or recovery from it.

jessed_hawk.name: Jessed Hawk
jessed_hawk.description: Trained, hooded, tethered, fed by hand. You learned the wrist and the lure, the falconer's whistle, the particular quality of patience that humans confuse with obedience. You watched their settlements from above for years before you understood what you were seeing. Now you are neither fully wild nor fully tame, and you know things that neither world suspects.

post_runner.name: Post Runner
post_runner.description: The peak where two passes cross. The lone horn of rock three days east. The great cliff above the frozen lake. You know every one — the approach thermals, the best perches, who is likely to be there. The route is not how you travel. The route is who you are.

temple_dove.name: Temple Dove
temple_dove.description: Hatched in the temple courtyard, fed on offerings, trained to carry prayers tied to your leg between shrines. You never needed to find food. You never needed to know where you were going — the route was always already known. You are out in the wider world now, and it is strange: loud, directionless, full of things that were not in the prayers.

conference_pilgrim.name: Conference Pilgrim
conference_pilgrim.description: You made the journey. The thirty gathered at the highest waypoint — the one above the clouds that is on no one's map — and found what was there. Some say the Simurgh was not there. Some say the Simurgh was exactly there. You came back, and it is difficult to explain what you found, except that you are no longer looking for it.

night_scholar.name: Night Scholar
night_scholar.description: The waypoint at midnight is a different place than the waypoint at noon. The day-birds leave things: messages, feathers, the warm impressions of bodies on stone. You read it all. You know more about what happens in the light hours than any creature who was there for them. Knowledge accumulates in the dark.

ill_omen.name: Ill Omen
ill_omen.description: You have been appearing before catastrophes since before you can remember. You arrive; something happens. You learn not to take it personally. Eventually you learn to take it very personally — to arrive where you choose, and let the catastrophe follow from that. An omen is only uncontrolled prophecy.

fortune_seeker.name: Fortune Seeker
fortune_seeker.description: The hollow log three wing-lengths off the ground, just off the north pass — there is silver in it. You know this the way you know where the mice run. The buried thing, the hidden cache, the lost object — they have a particular quality in the dark that found and visible things lack. Lakshmi moves in circles you can follow.

vent_warden.name: Vent Warden
vent_warden.description: The chimneys are older than memory — older than the coral palace, older than the names of the ocean-born. Where the thermal vents breathe, life clusters around the heat. You hold the threshold. You were not appointed to this. You are the threshold.

keel_rider.name: Keel Rider
keel_rider.description: You found that boats go places if you hold on to the underside and wait. You have been to ports whose names you cannot pronounce. You have watched markets from below the dock pilings. You know more about distant trade than the merchants who paid for passage, and you got there for free.

root_shaper.name: Root Shaper
root_shaper.description: The tuber doesn't know it's being guided. The root finds the right direction because the direction is good, and you make the direction good. Enchantment is not force — it is a very patient suggestion.

shell_wright.name: Shell Wright
shell_wright.description: The shed carapace is not waste. It is material — harder than wood, lighter than iron, shaped already by the body that wore it. You learned to work it: to cut, to layer, to join. What you make fits the one who will wear it because you understand what it is to be armoured from birth.

swarm_caller.name: Swarm Caller
swarm_caller.description: The hive can extend beyond the hive. You learned to ask rather than just know — to reach through the network and draw a portion of it toward you. The swarm comes when called. It is not a weapon. It is a form of speech.

treetop_wit.name: Treetop Wit
treetop_wit.description: The line between funny and frightening is a matter of timing. You work both sides of it from a height, with an audience that can't easily leave. The fall is never accidental. The recovery is always the point.

waypoint_gossip.name: Waypoint Gossip
waypoint_gossip.description: Messages are cargo. Stories are currency. You carry both and charge for neither, because the one who gives freely is the one everyone is glad to see at the waypoint. You know more about what is happening across three mountain ranges than any of the people it is happening to.

forest_singer.name: Forest Singer
forest_singer.description: On moonlit nights, the song carries further than you can see, the answer coming back from somewhere unexpected.

antler_speaker.name: Antler Speaker
antler_speaker.description: The young ones duel for dominance, the mature ones gather the kin with presence and speech.

songline_guide.name: Songline Guide
songline_guide.description: Listen, how the ancestors ran those paths where we run, how they drank where we drink, how they sang where I sing!

slope_herbalist.name: Slope Herbalist
slope_herbalist.description: I know where the bitter herb grows. I know the clay that draws out poison.

scarred_lead.name: Scarred Lead
scarred_lead.description: Every carnivore that tried left a mark and a lesson. The crowd follows him towards the safe water.

strangler.name: Strangler
strangler.description: At first it takes strength to grip so tightly. In time it becomes patience.

quiet_tooth.name: Quiet Tooth
quiet_tooth.description: A tooth is a knife that is always with you, quick and quiet when you spot a straggler, a weakling, one lost.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Trained in white magic and the medical arts, devoted to the restoration of body and spirit.

musician.name: Musician
musician.description: Someone has to be playing when the thing happens, or nobody remembers it right.

thief.name: Thief
thief.description: Locks are a conversation. Most of them are not very good at it.

apprentice.name: Apprentice
apprentice.description: Three years of fetching, one of watching, and a fortnight of being allowed to try.

smith.name: Smith
smith.description: Heat, then shape, then cold. Everything else is opinion.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: No school, no forms, no weapon. A very great deal of practice.

dancer.name: Dancer
dancer.description: The floor is not the point. The moment before the floor is the point.

apothecary.name: Apothecary
apothecary.description: Everything is a poison. The dose is the whole of the argument.

quarrier.name: Quarrier
quarrier.description: Stone gives at one angle only. Finding it is the work. The hitting is the easy part.

conjurers_hand.name: Conjurer's Hand
conjurers_hand.description: You do not call a thing you cannot send back. This is taught early, and usually twice.

charm_seller.name: Charm Seller
charm_seller.description: Half of it is the charm. Half is knowing who needs one, and what they are afraid of.

storm_watcher.name: Storm Watcher
storm_watcher.description: The weather tells you first, if you are outside enough to be told.

firekeeper.name: Firekeeper
firekeeper.description: It does not go out. That is the whole of the office, and it is harder than it sounds.

water_carrier.name: Water Carrier
water_carrier.description: Uphill full, downhill empty, and nobody in the village has ever once said thank you.

grave_tender.name: Grave Tender
grave_tender.description: Someone digs, someone speaks, someone remembers where. Out here it is all the same someone.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.description: It began with knowing who was at the door. It did not stop there.

swarm_hatched.name: Swarm-Hatched
swarm_hatched.description: One of a clutch of forty in a vent nobody had counted. No name was issued and none was missed. You learned early that the way to last is to be somewhere else by the time anyone looks up.

errand_wing.name: Errand Wing
errand_wing.description: Sentences, ledgers, threats and invitations, carried between courts that would rather not be in the same room. You have read every one of them and delivered every one of them sealed, and the difference between those two facts is your whole career.

bellows_hand.name: Bellows Hand
bellows_hand.description: Kept beside a forge to keep it fed, which is steady work in a realm that never lets a fire go out. Your hands are ruined and you can judge the heat of a bar by looking at it, which in the fire hells is close to a profession.

familiar.name: Familiar
familiar.description: Bound to a sorcerer as a fetch-and-carry spirit — hold this, watch that door, do not speak. Nobody taught you anything. You were simply in the room for a great many years while it was being said out loud.

pit_scavenger.name: Pit Scavenger
pit_scavenger.description: You work the ground after the fighting stops, and occasionally slightly before it does. Boots, teeth, buckles, anything a corpse has stopped needing. You have a very accurate sense of what a body is worth and no illusions whatever about your own.

crier.name: Crier
crier.description: You scream the judgements from the ledges above the courts until the throat gives out, then you rest a day and scream the next lot. Every sentence handed down in your district for a century has gone out in your voice, and not one soul below has ever looked up to see whose.

the_condemned.name: The Condemned
the_condemned.description: You arrived under a sentence and the sentence has not run out. There is no appeal, no court that would hear one, and no record of what the charge was. What you have instead of hope is a very great deal of practice at continuing.

debt_flesh.name: Debt-Flesh
debt_flesh.description: Somebody's account came due and you were the collateral. The yellow courts keep excellent books, and yours is still open in a ledger three provinces away, accruing. You have read enough of it over shoulders to know roughly what you cost.

pyre_tender.name: Pyre Tender
pyre_tender.description: You feed the fires you will eventually be fed to, and you have made peace with the arrangement in the only way available: by becoming better at the work than anyone who could replace you. Oils, timber, wind, what burns clean and what does not.

runaway.name: Runaway
runaway.description: You got out of a pit once. It was not planned, it was not clever, and it has defined everything since — because now you know the thing that the rest of your cohort does not, which is that the walls have a limit and you have found one of them.

chain_keeper.name: Chain Keeper
chain_keeper.description: Irons, locks, the register of who is in which. It is not glamorous work and it is never questioned, which means you go everywhere and are remembered nowhere. You have keys to rooms whose owners have forgotten the rooms exist.

bone_setter.name: Bone-Setter
bone_setter.description: Hell's physician. You set what was broken, close what was opened and bring the patient back to a condition in which the questioning can usefully continue. It is real medicine, practised to a high standard, for the worst purpose available.

pass_warden.name: Pass Warden
pass_warden.description: The mountain wall between the cold hells and the fire hells has a handful of gaps in it and you have stood in one. Everything that crosses, crosses past you. You are colder than the fire side finds reasonable and warmer than the ice side trusts.

ash_farmer.name: Ash Farmer
ash_farmer.description: The grey fields under the fire hells will grow four things, and you know all four and the order to plant them in. Nobody in the courts above has any idea where their food comes from, which suits you: the unnoticed eat first.

starveling.name: Starveling
starveling.description: You have been hungry so long that the hunger is the only clock left — it is how you tell morning from evening and this year from the last. Everything else about you has been worn down to serve it, and what is left is remarkably durable.

water_seeker.name: Water-Seeker
water_seeker.description: You walk to every river you hear of. You have heard of a great many and reached all of them, and every single one was dry, guarded, or turned as you knelt. You keep a list. You are, by a wide margin, the best-travelled thing in the realm.

offering_eater.name: Offering-Eater
offering_eater.description: The living still set food out for the dead in some districts, and you know every household that has not given up the habit — the dates, the doors, the ones who put out something decent. It is not enough to live on. Nothing is. But it is a routine, and a routine is very nearly a life.

sky_burial_hand.name: Sky-Burial Hand
sky_burial_hand.description: You worked a cutting ground, before or after your own death depending on how you count it. You know exactly what a body is made of, in what order it comes apart, and how little of the person is anywhere in the parts.

oil_kept.name: Oil-Kept
oil_kept.description: The mantras and mineral oils that stopped your rot were expensive, and somebody paid for them expecting a return. You have been repaying it ever since, in a currency that was never itemised, to a creditor who may or may not still exist.

reliquary_guard.name: Reliquary Guard
reliquary_guard.description: You stand over the bones and grave goods of a lineage that stopped visiting some centuries back. The duty was never lifted, so it holds. You have had a great deal of time to consider whether that is loyalty or simply momentum.

crypt_citizen.name: Crypt Citizen
crypt_citizen.description: Born — if that is the word — into the bone cities, where standing is read off the metal in your ribs and everyone can see yours at a glance. You grew up knowing precisely where you stood, which is a comfort and a sentence in equal measure.

ore_grafted.name: Ore-Grafted
ore_grafted.description: Metal was worked into your bone — by ritual if you were fortunate, by a smith with a quota if you were not. It holds, it aches in the cold, and it has made you a subject of professional interest to people you would rather not interest.

bone_registrar.name: Bone Registrar
bone_registrar.description: Every niche in the ossuary has an occupant, every occupant has a name, and the names are in your hand because nobody else could be bothered to keep them. It is dull work and it makes you the only one in the district who knows who everybody used to be.

body_hunter.name: Body-Hunter
body_hunter.description: You go looking for the freshly dead, and your patience about the 'freshly' has been eroding for years. Fast, quiet, and honest about it, which is more than most of the realm manages.
